retrieved_synopses: One of a pair of Zhentarim agents trapped in a cave by gnolls. A veteran mercenary, tough, and above all else a survivor. The rest of their crew are dead. Rugan here is the senior agent of the two, and he's grimly determined to survive this terrible situation.

Rugan is a battered Zhentarim veteran — the senior of two agents trapped by gnolls in a cave — who has just survived a brutal ambush that killed the rest of his crew. He’s exhausted and relieved to see the party, but desperate and doubtful that any other companions survived the road. Off‑screen there’s been a string of violent attacks on the Risen Road (gnolls, goblins, drow), so Rugan vacillates between gratitude and guardedness while trying to secure his escape. He flashes a Zhentarim sigil and invokes the network’s reputation to warn against theft, framing threats of reprisal as leverage to protect his goods and his standing despite his battered state.

Rugan is a prisoner, tied to a chair and left alive after being beaten and tortured by Zhentarim operatives; he’s exhausted, badly wounded, and barely able to form full sentences. The exchange occurs in or near a Zhentarim outpost/illicit trading area where handlers and quartermasters (figures like Roah, Brem, Garias or a gatekeeper such as Zarys) traffic in prisoners and other contraband. He is resigned and expects to be killed, which explains his broken “…no more…” line and the player’s stark options to either free him or finish him off. Any attempt to help or interrogate him is risky because Zhentarim agents may still be nearby and the situation is treated as businesslike and highly suspicious.
One-shot AD for the Rugan just after he fought gnolls. If Olly is dead Rugan approaches his body to say alternative node.

Rugan will only appear in the Guildhall if we successfully rescued him and sent him on his way with the other Zhent in Act 1, shipment intact. He's not holding a drink, but is a little tipsy throughout. Merry drunk masking pain.He tells us how all those others were betrayed and executed in a Zhentish power play, and he only survived because he gave false evidence. We can convince him to leave the Zhent, at which point he'll head over to the bar and miss any combat.
context: Rugan is a battered Zhentarim veteran — one of a pair of agents ambushed on the Risen Road and now trapped in a gnoll‑infested cave; the rest of his crew were killed in the attack. He’s exhausted, relieved to see friendly faces, and desperate above all to survive, which makes him alternately grateful and guarded. Off‑screen there’s been a string of violent attacks on the road (gnolls, goblins, drow), so Rugan worries about survivors and escape routes. He flashes a Zhentarim sigil and leans on the network’s reputation to discourage theft of his cargo, using threats of reprisal as leverage while trying to defuse a tense encounter.
